papers.title: Dapagliflozin in Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction

pages.text:
Abstract
Heart failure is a major cause of morbidity. The primary outcome was a composite of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death. Dapagliflozin may improve outcomes in patients with reduced ejection fraction.

Methods
We randomly assigned 4744 patients with heart failure and a reduced ejection fraction to receive dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily or placebo. The trial was double-blind and event-driven.

Results
The primary outcome occurred in 386 of 2373 patients (16.3%) in the dapagliflozin group and 502 of 2371 (21.2%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.65 to 0.85; P<0.001).

papers.title: 心力衰竭患者运动康复的随机对照试验

pages.text:
摘要
本研究评估运动康复对心力衰竭患者预后的影响。主要结局是心血管死亡或心力衰竭住院的复合终点。

方法
共纳入 120 名心力衰竭患者，随机分为运动康复组和常规护理组，随访 12 个月。

结果
运动康复组的主要结局发生率为 18.3%，常规护理组为 29.8%（风险比 0.61，95% 置信区间 0.42 至 0.89）。

papers.title: Metformin and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes

pages.text:
Abstract
Metformin is widely used in type 2 diabetes, but its effect on cardiovascular outcomes remains uncertain. We therefore conducted a randomized placebo-controlled trial.

Methods
We randomly assigned 2000 adults with type 2 diabetes to metformin or placebo and followed them for a median of 4.5 years.

Results
Metformin did not significantly reduce the primary composite cardiovascular outcome (hazard ratio 0.92; 95% CI 0.78 to 1.09).
